name: VTK Color Transfer Function Interpolation Modes
definition: A method for mapping scalar values to colors using various interpolation spaces (RGB, HSV, CIELAB, PROLAB, Diverging, Step) within a color transfer function.
summary: VTK Color Transfer Function Interpolation Modes map scalar values to colors using spaces like CIELAB or specialized behaviors like Diverging, offering perceptually uniform alternatives to standard linear RGB interpolation.
